A number has three digits in base \(5\) exactly when

\[
5^2 \le n \le 5^3-1
\]

so

\[
25 \le n \le 124.
\]

A number has two digits in base \(8\) exactly when

\[
8^1 \le n \le 8^2-1
\]

so

\[
8 \le n \le 63.
\]

Taking both conditions together:

\[
25 \le n \le 63.
\]

So the integers are all consecutive integers from \(25\) to \(63\). Their average is the average of the endpoints:

\[
\frac{25+63}{2} = \frac{88}{2} = 44.
\]
